payload.description: Canonical semantic payload: input/output hashes, engine and contract identity, checks, decision ids. Never document bodies, comment text, raw XML, secrets, or absolute paths.

provenance.description: Time and run identity; excluded from semantic equivalence.

producer.description: Engine identity, operation, and operation_id that produced the manifest.

source.description: Immutable schema-1 source identities: content inventory hash and semantic workdir manifest hash.

baseline.description: Template/baseline identities copied verbatim from format.json: template, template_sha256, package_manifest, source, source_sha256, styles_sha256, document_xml_sha256, source_track_enabled, uses_date_utc.

features.description: supported/required feature names; consumers must fail closed on unknown required features.

state.description: Semantic/readiness state: edit freshness, revision/comment counts, reason codes, semantic workdir manifest hash.

checks.description: Verification checks run before publish (asset closure, byte/semantic equivalence, typed validation, behavior equivalence).

items.description: Every migrated asset: path, kind (authoritative/optional/opaque/generated), required, read_only, role, presence, bytes, sha256, mtime_ns. The manifest declares itself as the single generated asset whose sha256/bytes/mtime_ns are null (a file cannot truthfully hash or measure the bytes containing its own declaration); every other present asset carries real size, hash, and mtime.

edit-span-crosses-protected-marker.note: old text is visible but split by anchors/hyperlinks/fields (not revisions); edit inside one span or per span.

allow_comment_text.description: Comment paragraphs (comments.P*) are annotation content; replaces there require explicit opt-in.

output.description: The .docx to verify; may be omitted right after build_docx (the session remembers the published output).

hunks.description: Replace/insert/delete hunks; a replace hunk may address its text with match_ref instead of paragraph_id+old.

track.description: Choose the edit mode in this call: true = tracked revisions, false = direct. Removes the edit-mode-ambiguous round trip.

paragraph_id.description: Target paragraph; may be omitted when match_ref carries it.

span_index.description: Index of the editable span from document_read view=spans (exact address; mutually exclusive with old).
